_why: The two steps this driver exists for are the two an operator skips, and both fail SILENTLY: a stale BASE reviews the previous commit and comes back clean, and a review that read nothing returns a confident verdict word. So the mutations attack the ORDER and the REFUSALS, not the happy path -- every one of them leaves a run that still prints a verdict-shaped line.

mutations.name: a-review-that-read-nothing-is-recorded
mutations._mechanism: The 1510-confident-bytes defect, restored. The reviewer read nothing, its last line says READY_TO_MERGE, and that word reaches orchestrator state -- after which every later gate is judging a review that never happened.

mutations.name: the-verdict-gate-runs-before-the-evidence-gate
mutations._mechanism: Order IS the contract. Extract first and a hollow review with a verdict word is recorded before anything asks whether it read -- the gates both exist, in the wrong sequence, which reads as correct in review.

mutations.name: the-readback-is-dropped
mutations._mechanism: `archreview` is not in the schema's `required` array, so a write that never landed still reports STATE: PASS. Without the comparison the driver reports `recorded=yes` about a field that is absent.

mutations.name: the-first-assessment-wins
mutations._mechanism: The prompt instructs the reviewer to 'return ASSESSMENT: NO if your reads fail', so the review echoes a verdict word before it produces one. First-match reads the instruction back -- J39 in a different file.

mutations.name: a-degenerate-range-is-staged
mutations._mechanism: BASE == HEAD is an empty diff. The review runs, examines nothing, and returns READY_TO_MERGE truthfully -- the stale-sha failure of J41 one level up, where the wrong range is indistinguishable from a clean feature.

mutations.name: a-live-placeholder-ships-in-the-prompt
mutations._mechanism: A prompt still carrying `<INLINE_...>` asks the reviewer to review a placeholder, and reads as a real prompt to the dispatcher, the log and the extractor alike.

mutations.name: tree-stage-snapshot-dropped
mutations._mechanism: Stage must leave the baseline beside the prompt before review begins.

mutations.name: tree-stage-uses-cwd-instead-of-design-repo
mutations._mechanism: The design repository supplies the baseline even when cwd and prompt are elsewhere.

mutations.name: tree-untracked-paths-omitted
mutations._mechanism: Untracked files belong to the measured tree, including filenames with spaces.

mutations.name: tree-current-bytes-not-hashed
mutations._mechanism: The baseline must hash current binary file bytes, not an empty or decoded representation.

mutations.name: tree-deletion-tombstone-lost
mutations._mechanism: Missing status paths must remain visible as deleted tombstones.

mutations.name: tree-stage-failure-becomes-fatal
mutations._mechanism: Snapshot failure is advisory and must leave the staged prompt and successful exit intact.

mutations.name: tree-score-opt-in-ignored
mutations._mechanism: An explicitly requested comparison must run after scoring.

mutations.name: tree-score-runs-without-opt-in
mutations._mechanism: Without the flag the legacy score output must remain byte-identical.

mutations.name: tree-new-paths-not-compared
mutations._mechanism: Paths introduced after the baseline are changes even if absent from the old map.

mutations.name: tree-disappearing-paths-not-compared
mutations._mechanism: An untracked path removed after the baseline must still appear in the diff.

mutations.name: tree-hash-differences-ignored
mutations._mechanism: A dirty path whose current bytes change is a finding even if its status is unchanged.

mutations.name: tree-head-movement-ignored
mutations._mechanism: A commit changes the measured revision even when the dirty-path map is identical.

mutations.name: tree-head-only-change-silenced
mutations._mechanism: HEAD movement alone must choose CHANGED rather than UNCHANGED.

mutations.name: tree-changed-path-order-reversed
mutations._mechanism: Findings must list changed paths in sorted order.
mutations.find:
changed = sorted(p for p in before.keys() | after.keys()
                         if before.get(p) != after.get(p))
mutations.replace:
changed = sorted((p for p in before.keys() | after.keys()
                          if before.get(p) != after.get(p)), reverse=True)

mutations.name: tree-snapshot-self-exclusion-dropped
mutations._mechanism: The snapshot is a cycle channel and cannot report its own rewritten bytes.

mutations.name: tree-review-channel-exclusion-dropped
mutations._mechanism: The last-message file is review output and excluded from tree findings.

mutations.name: tree-report-channel-exclusion-dropped
mutations._mechanism: The report file is review output and excluded from tree findings.

mutations.name: tree-log-channel-exclusion-dropped
mutations._mechanism: The dispatch log is review output and excluded from tree findings.

mutations.name: tree-done-channel-exclusion-dropped
mutations._mechanism: Completion markers beside each output channel must also be excluded.

mutations.name: tree-old-map-exclusion-dropped
mutations._mechanism: Old channel entries must be filtered as well as newly observed channel entries.
mutations.replace: if snapshot is old or (root / p).resolve() not in excluded}

mutations.name: tree-current-map-exclusion-dropped
mutations._mechanism: New channel entries must be filtered as well as old baseline entries.
mutations.replace: if snapshot is current or (root / p).resolve() not in excluded}

mutations.name: tree-unreadable-snapshot-silenced
mutations._mechanism: An unreadable snapshot must emit one advisory finding, never imply UNCHANGED.

mutations.name: tree-invalid-json-silenced
mutations._mechanism: Malformed JSON must produce an unreadable finding rather than a clean diff.

mutations.name: tree-invalid-schema-silenced
mutations._mechanism: A JSON value without the snapshot schema is unreadable rather than unchanged.

mutations.name: tree-finding-overrides-score-exit
mutations._mechanism: A tree change must not turn a recorded review verdict into an operational failure.
mutations.replace: return 2 if args.tree_snapshot is not None else result

mutations.name: tree-finding-skipped-on-score-refusal
mutations._mechanism: The comparison must still run when the evidence gate refuses to record a verdict.
mutations.replace: if args.tree_snapshot is not None and result == 0:
